title: Single-degree left-edge comparison before coefficient identification
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian B and C with derived categories and an additive left exact functor G, the canonical lift of G of the cycle inclusion of the single complex A[n], followed by homology projection and the hypercohomology left edge, equals G applied to the homology projection of A[n].

proof.text: For S=A[n], extend by zero to L. Use extendSingleIso to prove L is supported in degree n and QL is LE n and GE 0. Set f = inverse truncLT inclusion followed by truncGE projection and the canonical single-degree truncation comparison. The source-library homology comparison lemma and cancellation prove f induces the identity on H^n.

Apply the proved truncation-edge factorization. Transport the mapped cycle lift through extendCyclesIso and mapExtendIso, using their component formulas and the characterizing cycle inclusion equation. Homology-projection naturality gives the corresponding homology transport.

Apply the derived-unit normalization on the integer-indexed single-degree complex L to f and its mapped cycle lift. Compose with the quotient and extension homology comparisons. Functoriality, the extension homology projection equation, and inverse cancellations yield G of the original homology projection.

proof_origin.place: Single-complex specialization of Tag 015J; explicit truncation, extension and unit assembly by A3.
proof_origin.note: Decomposition: spectral truncation and extension transport proved, only derived-unit normalization split off.

lean.statement:
theorem cochainHypercohomologyLeftEdge_single_aux (A : B) (n : ℕ) :
    let S := (HomologicalComplex.single B (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n).obj A
    let T := (G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj S
    let a := T.liftCycles (G.map (S.iCycles n)) (n + 1) (by simp) (by
      change G.map (S.iCycles n) ≫ G.map (S.d n (n + 1)) = 0
      rw [← G.map_comp, S.iCycles_d, G.map_zero])
    a ≫ T.homologyπ n ≫ G.cochainHypercohomologyLeftEdge S n =
      G.map (S.homologyπ n)
